reason: I live two hours from my mother and I lose sleep over it, so the idea makes sense. But I have never heard of this company, there are no reviews I can find, and I would not spend $249 plus a monthly fee on a brand-new product while I wait for proof it works for families like mine.
objection: My mother will pull it off or refuse to wear it, and then I have paid for a thing that sits in a drawer. A clip or lanyard means nothing if she takes it off the moment I leave the room.
would_change_my_mind: Reviews from other families with early-stage dementia in the Alzheimer's support groups I read, saying the device stayed on for weeks and the SOS actually connected when it was needed.
